001package org.clafer.compiler;
002
003import org.clafer.instance.InstanceModel;
004
005/**
006 * Resource limit reached on an optimization problem with the best known
007 * solution thus far.
008 *
009 * <pre>
010 * solver.limitTime(1000);
011 * try {
012 *   solver.find();
013 * } catch (ReachedLimitBestKnownException rle) {
014 *   // This is an optimization problem and 1000ms has passed.
015 *   // Although the solver did not complete, it returned the best known
016 *   // (but possibly non-optimal) instance after 1000ms. This instance is
017 *   // stored in the rle exception.
018 *   while (rle.find()) {
019 *     System.out.println("Approximate solutions: " + rle.instance());
020 *   }
021 * } catch (ReachedLimitException rle) {
022 *   // 1000ms has passed.
023 * }
024 * </pre>
025 *
026 * @author jimmy
027 */
028public class ReachedLimitBestKnownException extends ReachedLimitException implements OptimalInstanceIterator {
029
030    private final InstanceModel[] instances;
031    private final int[][] objectiveValues;
032    private int count = 0;
033
034    public ReachedLimitBestKnownException(InstanceModel[] instances, int[][] objectiveValues) {
035        this.instances = instances;
036        this.objectiveValues = objectiveValues;
037    }
038
039    public ReachedLimitBestKnownException(InstanceModel instance, int[] objectiveValues) {
040        this.instances = new InstanceModel[]{instance};
041        this.objectiveValues = new int[][]{objectiveValues};
042    }
043
044    @Override
045    public boolean find() {
046        if (count < instances.length) {
047            count++;
048            return true;
049        }
050        return false;
051    }
052
053    @Override
054    public InstanceModel instance() {
055        if (count == 0 || count > instances.length) {
056            throw new IllegalStateException("No instances. Did you forget to call find?");
057        }
058        return instances[count - 1];
059    }
060
061    @Override
062    public int[] optimalValues() {
063        if (count == 0 || count > instances.length) {
064            throw new IllegalStateException("No instances. Did you forget to call find?");
065        }
066        return objectiveValues[count - 1];
067    }
068
069    @Override
070    public int instanceCount() {
071        return count;
072    }
073}
